description: This file defines the BesselJ class which implements the Bessel function calculation, including methods for specific orders and handling array inputs, as part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's engineering calculations.

classes.name: BesselJ
classes.description: Class providing Bessel function calculations for engineering purposes within PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: BESSELJ
methods.description: Main method to evaluate the Bessel function of the first kind for a given x and order, supporting array inputs and error handling.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Determines which specific Bessel function calculation to perform based on the order.

methods.name: besselJ0
methods.description: Calculates the Bessel function of order 0 for a given x.

methods.name: besselJ1
methods.description: Calculates the Bessel function of order 1 for a given x.

methods.name: besselJ2
methods.description: Calculates the Bessel function for orders greater than 1, choosing between two methods based on the magnitude of x.

methods.name: besselj2a
methods.description: Calculates Bessel function for large x using upward recurrence.

methods.name: besselj2b
methods.description: Calculates Bessel function for smaller x using downward recurrence.
